facts.fact: The queen gave Usha a folded strip of paper sealed in green wax, reading 'Ride with her. Press nothing.' Usha shows it unopened at the third post to get fresh horses.

Neela infers that the 'net-mender behind the sheds' Ammu credited was not real; the double hitch came from Neela's mother Ammini through Neela's own fingers, and Neela may have taught it to Ammu as a child.
Neela reads Ammu's jackal call as 'don't decide without me', given on nights Neela went off alone to settle something not hers alone.
